_comment: Independent public-input witness for win/tty/topl.c tty_yn_function() lines 444-447 and 451-459 with the default msg_window (single): an Archeologist looks here, opens the #pray confirmation and presses ^P twice inside it, so tty_doprev_message() walks cw->maxcol back through the history. The next key takes the doprev arm, whose tty_clear_nhwindow(WIN_MESSAGE) is followed by cw->maxcol = cw->maxrow, and n then answers. Two ^P at the command level start again from gt.toplines, the answered prompt, and then show the newest stored message.
